thread:
maya: heads up — spotted tenant-B metrics showing up in tenant-A's dashboard for two customers. screenshot: https://s.redwood/snap/abcd :eyes:

sam: ugh. reproducible? any query/logs?

maya: yes repro steps in a gist. quick summary: dashboard -> metrics v2 -> selects from telemetry_agg JOIN cached_customer_meta. the join condition is wrong so tenant filter gets applied after the join (bad).

reza: can you paste the query? thinking of cached_agg sharding issues.

maya: ```sql
SELECT t.metric, sum(t.value) as total
FROM telemetry_agg t
JOIN cached_customer_meta c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
-- missing AND c.tenant_id = :tenant_id here
WHERE t.window_start >= :start
GROUP BY t.metric;
```

linh: whoops. that explains it — tenant scoping was applied to t.customer_id but cached_customer_meta is from a global cache and gets joined in earlier.

product-ux: any customers exposed? we should notify if PII risk.

maya: limited to metrics and counts right now, not identifying PII fields, but still definitely a data-leak surface. saw it in two orgs in staging and one small prod instance.

ops-bot: incident-alert: :warning: anomalous cross-tenant metric readings detected (ID: ALRT-612). Triggers: dashboard-queries > threshold.

sam: quick mitigation: add tenant predicate into the JOIN and redeploy query layer. minimal diff: ```sql
JOIN cached_customer_meta c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = :tenant_id
```

oncall: i'm going to temporarily restrict dashboard access for affected tenants and flip the query caching to private mode for the metrics service to stop stale global caches being used. will post when done.

reza: i'll open an internal ticket and PR template. we should also add a unit/integration test in telemetry-agg that asserts all queries include tenant scoping before join optimizations.

maya: repro steps I used: 1) load telemetry for two customers with same customer_id under different tenants in staging, 2) refresh v2 dashboard 3) observe cross-tenant totals. attaching raw DB extract to the ticket.

product-ux: let's draft a short customer note in case we need to escalate — low severity for now but call it out.

linh: also check routing policies — if routing sent reads to a shared read-rep that has cache-bypass flags, we might have inconsistent apply order.

sam: agreed. i'll push hotfix to prod query layer and a follow-up PR with tests. ETA 45m.

oncall: dashboards restricted, cache mode = private. monitoring for ALRT-612 enabled.

maya: thanks team. can we add an eval/telemetry regression check in the console rollout workflow so this doesn't slip through future rollouts? maybe block canary if any dashboard shows cross-tenant spikes. :+1:

reza: adding that to the rollout checklist. assigning to eng-platform and eng-ml for instrumentation.

maya: 👍
